name: Firstsource Solutions Ltd.
about: Firstsource Solutions Limited provides technology-enabled business process services in Asia, the United Kingdom, the United States, and internationally. The company operates through four segments: Healthcare; Banking and Financial Services; Communications, Media and Technology; and Diverse Industries. It offers core banking, card and digital payments, consumer lending, mortgage, commercial lending, and fraud management; member enrollment, member engagement, digital mailroom, network operations, claims optimization, population health, and data intelligence solutions, as well as business process as a service solution; and patient access, revenue integrity, revenue recovery, and revenue command center solutions.
